## Summary
The text is cut off in the middle of clause 4, so this covers clauses 1 to 3 only. The Guide leads Kruja and Berat day tours at EUR 70 per tour day, paid within 30 days of invoice. Free cancellation ends 5 days before a tour. I cannot approve it: whether to sign is the Manager's decision, and most of the contract is missing.
